Wren will shut off the water for the winter on the work day itself. The notice will cover the Alder Lane Community Garden work day on Saturday 14 November 2026 from 09:30 to 12:30. Members should bring gloves. The club will provide soup. The tool sharpener will be on site from 10:00. The text will stick to the notes and avoid inventing extra details.

The notice will also mention that water will be shut off for the winter on the work day. Internal items such as invoices, fees, and checklist comments will be omitted. The draft is beginning with the heading.
